name: Service account key file (JSON)
description: Google Cloud service account key file in JSON form: a document whose private_key field holds a PEM-encoded private key as a JSON string, beside identifying fields such as project_id, private_key_id, client_email and client_id.
notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. A structured file, not a fixed-format token: the contract records which field holds the private portion and what the provider says about it, not a detection grammar. The embedded PEM block is the existing generic:private-key family (reviewed under #54); it is not re-reviewed here.
